Bosi breaks down the strategic choreography the protagonist and antagonist are being established for the target audience Senator Bernie Moreno delivered the emotional gut punch—asking Who the fuck do you think you were—while Senator Ron Johnson exposed the death toll of remdesivir versus the suppression of ivermectin RFK Jr dropped the bombshell Fauci funded gain-of-function research taught Wuhan scientists the technique and turned a public health agency into a bioweapons factory
